messages.ui.intro: Import Markdown files into Publii as editable draft posts.
messages.ui.dropFiles: Drop files here or select files
messages.ui.frontMatterHint: YAML front matter is optional. Title: front matter → opening main heading → filename.
messages.ui.author: Author
messages.ui.stripHeading: Remove the opening main heading from the text when it matches the title
messages.ui.draftNote: All posts are imported as drafts. Local images and attachments are not copied. External image URLs are preserved.
messages.ui.previewHint: Click a file in the list.
messages.ui.footer: Markdown Importer {version} · for Publii 0.48.1 or later · works locally without network requests
messages.ui.filesChecked: Files checked. Review your selection and start the import.
messages.ui.listCleared: List cleared. Previously imported posts are preserved.
messages.ui.importInProgress: Import in progress. Keep this view open until it finishes.
messages.ui.importCompleted: Imported drafts: {imported}; skipped: {skipped}. Posts are available in the post list.
messages.error.openInPublii: Open this plugin inside Publii under Tools & Plugins.
messages.error.connectionUnavailable: The Publii connection is unavailable. Publii 0.48.1 or later is required.
messages.error.noAuthors: No authors are available. Create an author in Publii first.
messages.error.invalidEncoding: The file is not valid UTF-8.
messages.error.scalar: Front matter field "{field}" must be a scalar value.
messages.error.frontMatterUnclosed: YAML front matter has no closing delimiter (---).
messages.error.frontMatterMapping: Front matter must be a mapping of fields and values.
messages.error.isoDate: Use an ISO date: YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO timestamp.
messages.error.websiteOrAuthor: The website or author is missing.
messages.error.timeout: Publii is not responding. Import stopped; check the post list before trying again.
messages.error.sessionUnavailable: An import is running or the last save status is uncertain. Reopen the plugin.
messages.error.authorUnavailable: The selected author is no longer available.
messages.error.websiteChanged: The website has changed. Import stopped.
messages.error.slugFailed: Publii could not create a URL slug.
messages.error.saveUnconfirmed: The save was not confirmed. Import stopped; check the post list.
messages.warning.unknownMetadata: Unknown metadata fields will not be imported.
messages.warning.author: The author is set using the selection in the importer.
messages.warning.status: Front matter status is ignored: posts are imported as drafts.
messages.warning.template: The template/layout is determined by the current Publii theme.
messages.warning.featuredImage: The featured image from front matter will not be imported.
messages.warning.localPaths: Local image/file paths detected: files are not copied. Update paths after importing.
